# #646 — capture-gate live defects: receipt probe hits a nonexistent endpoint (HTML 404), and the provider scope-proof demands a key it rejects

State: CLOSED
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none

First live firing of capture-gate.ts (PR #642, ledger item 24) on the controller's merge of PR #645 exposed the two gaps that PR's own report named as PROPOSED (fixture-proven only):

1. **Receipt probe endpoint does not exist on live Open Brain.** The gate's refusal text shows the service answering `Cannot POST /too...` (HTML error page) — the receipt query URL is wrong against the real server, so the gate can NEVER see a real receipt; every merge with the service up is refused as a skip.
2. **Provider scope-proof is self-contradictory from a head session.** `openbrain-memory` capture fails with "session_start result did not prove exact Open Brain scope: agent, channel_id, server_id, source" — but including `source` in scope fails with "scope contains unsupported keys: source". It demands a key it refuses to accept, so a head session cannot produce the receipt the gate requires by any spelling.
3. **Drain path degraded in the hook environment:** `runtime unavailable: No module named 'openbrain_memory'` — the gate's drain-first step cannot import the client package from the hook's interpreter.

Combined effect: the gate structurally blocks ALL merges including the merge of its own fix — an enforcement wedge. Operator ruling pending on interim disposition (unregister-and-fix-forward vs hold-all-merges). Fix requirements, red-first: a done-means clause that queries the REAL service for a receipt written through the REAL provider path (the seeded-spool drain-delivers clause PR #642 already named), plus a provider fix or documented scope spelling a head session can satisfy, plus the hook interpreter gaining the client package. Related: #451 (remains open for exactly these live gaps).
